name: Maternity allowance paid to the worker (生育津贴冲抵)
authority: 沪医保规〔2021〕9号 (to 30 June 2026, https://ybj.sh.gov.cn/gfxwj/20220221/896fab70895744b19f48655977d25a19.html) and 沪医保规〔2026〕5号 (from 1 July 2026, https://www.shanghai.gov.cn/gwk/search/content/79e981546eaf4727ae47502f4de955b8) item 4: 从业妇女享受的生育生活津贴标准低于本人产假前工资标准的，差额部分由其生育或者流产时所在用人单位按国家规定支付. The allowance is claimed by the worker (随申办) and paid by the fund; MATERNITY_LEAVE is paid leave, so where the fund paid the allowance to the worker this line takes that allowance back off the wage the leave days priced: the worker keeps max(wage, allowance). The amount is the allowance the fund paid for this pay month’s leave days, recorded as the agency paid it; the line never exceeds the wage the salary window prices for its MATERNITY_LEAVE days (person.period.leave_pay: salary × leave days ÷ working days), so a part month takes back no more than the leave days’ wage. Owner rule 2026-09-28: 产假前工资 is read as the contract wage the leave row prices; the allowance is a fund benefit, not wages (Social Insurance Law art.56), so the offset leaves the IIT base and the art.47 average (财税〔2008〕8号 exempts the allowance). Where the fund paid the employer, no line is raised.
